channel.title: TechScoop News
channel.description: Latest tech news and insights from TechScoop - MENA's leading technology publication

item.title: Foras AI increases stake in Beban to support AI adoption across Egypt and MENA
item.description: Foras AI increases its stake in Beban as part of its Egypt market entry strategy, linking MENA expansion with broader regional digital transformation goals under Vision 2030 and Egypt’s innovation ecosystem.

item.title: Global financial services firm Apex Group opens Qatar Financial Centre office
item.description: Apex Group expands its global footprint with a newly regulated office in Qatar Financial Centre (QFC), strengthening its asset servicing, fund administration, and corporate solutions offerings in the Middle East.

item.title: EFG Hermes ONE App introduces five funds across Equities, Gold, and Fixed Income
item.description: EFG Hermes has launched five mutual funds on its EFG Hermes ONE app for retail investors, with diversified fund profiles including money market, USD fixed income, gold, equity, and Shariah compliant equity, widening access to professionally managed products.

item.title: Saudi Egyptian VC EDAFA plans $10M deployment across Egypt’s startup ecosystem
item.description: EDAFA is targeting USD 10 million in investments into Egyptian startups in 2026, expanding its portfolio across early stage ventures and aligning with national entrepreneurship growth strategies.

item.title: Angelic Intelligence lands $15M to accelerate Middle East growth
item.description: Angelic Intelligence raises USD 15 million to expand its AI driven enterprise solutions across the Middle East, signaling growing investor interest in regional artificial intelligence adoption.

item.title: TechScoop Test Article - OG Meta Tags Verification
item.description: This is a test article created to verify that Open Graph meta tags are working correctly for social media sharing. Each article should display unique title, description, and featured image when shared.

item.title: UAE formalizes electronic invoicing model to modernize tax reporting
item.description: UAE Ministry of Finance issues Electronic Invoicing Guidelines to support the national e invoicing rollout, advancing digital tax compliance and business automation across the country.

item.title: UAE sets governance framework for AI use in Finance
item.description: UAE Central Bank issues new guidance on the responsible use of artificial intelligence in financial services, outlining governance, risk management and compliance standards for regulated entities.

item.title: Central Bank of Oman moves to regulate BNPL sector with new licensing rules
item.description: The Central Bank of Oman issues new regulations governing Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) services, establishing a formal framework for licensing, consumer protection, and fintech oversight in the Sultanate.

item.title: Abu Dhabi’s $100M Presight–Shorooq fund accelerates frontier AI investments
item.description: The $100 million Presight–Shorooq AI Fund has backed five frontier artificial intelligence companies in its first quarter, underscoring rising institutional capital flows into advanced AI infrastructure and applications across global markets.

item.title: Garage Accelerator Launches 10th Cohort as Saudi Startup Program Marks Milestone
item.description: Saudi Arabia's Garage accelerator launches its 10th cohort, marking a milestone for the pioneering startup program that has supported over 100 companies since 2018. The program continues to play a central role in developing the Kingdom's tech ecosystem under Vision 2030.

item.title: Apple strengthens global age controls as governments push stricter online safety regulations
item.description: Apple is globally rolling out advanced age verification tools to comply with increasing child safety regulations worldwide. This move will impact users and developers across the MENA region, aligning with global efforts to enhance online protection for minors.

item.title: King Saud University enters the startup game with Riyadh Valley
item.description: King Saud University's investment arm has partnered with SparkLabs to establish a venture fund and four-month accelerator program launching in April. The move marks a significant shift in how major Gulf research institutions approach commercialization of academic research and represents a direct challenge to private venture firms dominating early-stage funding in Saudi Arabia.

item.title: SparkLabs teams up with Riyadh Valley to strengthen Saudi university startup ecosystem
item.description: Riyadh Valley company launches a new venture capital fund and business accelerator in partnership with SparkLabs within King Saud University, strengthening Saudi Arabia’s university backed startup ecosystem.

item.title: Dubai Future District Fund invests in Immensa to boost advanced manufacturing
item.description: Immensa secures backing from the Dubai Future District Fund (DFDF) to expand its digital supply chain platform, reinforcing regional investment in advanced manufacturing and Industry 4.0 technologies.

item.title: Scopely advances Global expansion with $1 Billion Loom move
item.description: Scopely is expanding its global gaming footprint with a $1 billion deal involving Loom, reinforcing the Kingdom’s broader strategy to invest in interactive entertainment and digital gaming infrastructure.

item.title: UAE proptech startup Takeem joins REACH Middle East with Second Century Ventures Support
item.description: Takeem has secured strategic backing from Second Century Ventures through the REACH Middle East accelerator, marking a significant milestone for the region’s growing real estate technology ecosystem.

item.title: PIF-backed Lucid Motors cuts 800 jobs to turn profitable
item.description: Lucid Motors, the California electric vehicle maker backed by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, laid off roughly 800 salaried employees on Friday

item.title: Saudi Aramco's LAB7 is looking for the next big idea in chips and AI
item.description: AB7, its innovation arm based in Dhahran, Aramco has teamed up with the World Economic Forum to run a global startup challenge focused on semiconductors and industrial AI, two areas sitting right at the center of the biggest technology race of our time.

item.title: Saudi accelerator Exel by Merak funds 17 startups with $5.1 Million
item.description: Exel by Merak has awarded $5.1 million to 17 startups graduating from its second gaming accelerator cohort, as part of the $80 million Merak Gaming Fund supporting Saudi Arabia’s games industry under Vision 2030.

item.title: Saudi AI firm HUMAIN backs xAI with $3 Billion series E investment
item.description: Saudi Arabia’s HUMAIN has taken a significant minority stake in xAI through a $3 billion Series E investment, deepening the Kingdom’s exposure to global artificial intelligence infrastructure and innovation.

item.title: Vision Ventures backs Deep.SA in early AI investment play
item.description: AI startup Deep.SA has closed a pre seed funding round with participation from Vision Ventures, marking early strategic backing as the company develops AI-driven solutions for enterprise markets across the GCC.

item.title: Origen bags $50M as cybersecurity spending rises across the Middle East
item.description: Cybersecurity platform Origen has secured a $50 million strategic investment from Bluefive Capital to expand managed detection and response services and accelerate regional growth.

item.title: Breadfast secures major funding round amid growth in Egypt’s e-commerce sector
item.description: Breadfast has raised $50 million in a pre series C round backed by regional and global investors, strengthening its expansion plans across Egypt and beyond as competition intensifies in MENA’s grocery delivery market.

item.title: UAE’s ZIWO secures strategic debt investment from Amplify Growth Fund
item.description: AI contact centre platform ZIWO has secured a strategic debt financing investment from Amplify Growth Fund, managed by Ajeej Capital, to support regional expansion, deepen partnerships, and scale AI driven capabilities across the GCC.

item.title: Dubai’s Stake secures $31 million in series B, eyes Saudi and U.S. markets
item.description: Digital real estate investment platform Stake has closed a $31 million Series B funding round led by banking group Emirates NBD, bringing its total venture capital raised to approximately $58 million and marking continued global expansion.

item.title: $12.6M round positions Flextock to capture rising e-commerce demand
item.description: E-commerce enablement startup Flextock has raised $12.6 million to scale its merchant growth platform, expanding fulfillment, logistics, and embedded services across the MENA region.

item.title: Saudi fintech Madfu bags $25.5M to accelerate BNPL growth
item.description: Saudi BNPL startup Madfu has raised $25.5 million to expand its fintech footprint across the Kingdom, accelerating growth in digital payments and consumer finance under Vision 2030.

item.title: $5.4M funding boost positions iBLOXX Studios for major game release
item.description: UAE based iBLOXX Studios has raised $5.4 million to support the development and release of its upcoming game, strengthening the country’s growing gaming and digital entertainment ecosystem.

item.title: Swvl deepens Saudi presence with new $1.5M healthcare contract
item.description: Swvl has expanded its operations in Saudi Arabia’s healthcare sector after securing a new $1.5 million contract, strengthening its position in enterprise mobility and institutional transport services in the Kingdom.

item.title: Saudi tech firm Solidrange bags $2.4M series A funding
item.description: Saudi startup Solidrange has raised $2.4 million in a series A investment round as it scales its technology driven solutions across the Kingdom’s growing digital economy.

item.title: Saudi payments startup CASHIN closes $16M series A
item.description: Saudi fintech CASHIN has raised $16 million in a Series A round led by Impact46, as it scales its digital cash management and payment infrastructure across Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Saudi's SAVVY eyes $6B moonton acquisition in gaming consolidation play
item.description: ByteDance is negotiating to sell Shanghai Moonton Technology to Saudi Arabia's Savvy Games Group for between $6 billion and $7 billion

item.title: UAE Fresh Commerce Startup QuicKart Raises 1.5 Million Dollars
item.description: Dubai-based QuicKart secures $1.5M seed funding led by Orbit Ventures to expand its farm-to-home fresh produce delivery across the UAE.

item.title: Pakistan Commits 1 Billion Dollars to AI Development by 2030
item.description: Pakistan launches Indus AI Week with $1B commitment to artificial intelligence, unveiling Islamabad AI Declaration and programs to train 1 million workers by 2030.

item.title: Aramco and Microsoft Partner on Industrial AI Deployment
item.description: Saudi Aramco has signed a deal with Microsoft to deploy artificial intelligence across its oil and gas operations, aiming to improve efficiency while keeping data inside the Kingdom. The partnership signed on February 12 focuses on four areas: digital sovereignty, operational efficiency, building a local tech ecosystem, and developing AI solutions that could be sold globally.

item.title: Singapore's Ascentium acquires UAE corporate services provider Clara
item.description: Singapore-based business services platform Ascentium has acquired Clara, a UAE-based regtech and corporate service provider, in a deal that expands Ascentium's presence across the Middle East's regulated financial hubs. Founded in 2018, Clara operates as the largest licensed corporate service provider in Abu Dhabi Global Market, serving startups, venture capitalists, and government entities through its proprietary compliance platform.

item.title: Nutra GreeniX eyes growth in Syria’s agritech sector after $200K seed round
item.description: Syrian agritech startup Nutra GreeniX has secured a $200,000 seed round led by EBLA Ventures as it seeks to scale sustainable livestock nutrition solutions across Syria.

item.title: CADO enters Qatar to build unified GCC gifting infrastructure
item.description: UAE based premium gifting platform CADO has launched in Qatar, strengthening its GCC footprint and building a unified, cross-border corporate gifting infrastructure across the region.

item.title: UAE proptech startup Smart Bricks eyes global scale with $5M pre seed funding
item.description: UAE based proptech startup Smart Bricks is scaling its AI powered real estate investment platform after securing $5 million in pre seed funding led by Andreessen Horowitz, positioning itself as an infrastructure layer for global property investing.

item.title: Saudi logistics tech startup Routech Express bags $1M pre seed round
item.description: Saudi logistics tech startup Routech Express has secured $1 million in pre seed funding led by Q Fund, aiming to expand its digital shipping platform across the Kingdom and beyond amid rising e-commerce demand, while reflecting broader regional trends in early stage startup investments.

item.title: Saudi Startup Jazr.io raises $213K to automate F&B financial operations
item.description: Saudi startup Jazr.io secures $213K in pre seed funding to scale its AI powered accounting and inventory platform designed for restaurants and cafés across the Kingdom.

item.title: UAE startup ThrowMeNot secures $550K pre seed to tackle food waste
item.description: UAE based startup ThrowMeNot secures $550,000 in pre seed funding led by Sheikh Ahmed bin Mana Al Maktoum to scale its food waste reduction marketplace and expand across the MENA region.

item.title: SiFi raises $20M series A to scale Saudi spend management platform
item.description: Saudi fintech Simplified Financial Solutions (SiFi) secures $20 million in Series A funding led by Ra’ed Ventures to scale its AI powered spend management platform, serving over 3,500 organizations across the Kingdom.

item.title: Infinity Value Capital leads $2M round for UAE’s Omnispay SME finance platform
item.description: UAE based fintech Omnispay secures $2 million in pre series A funding led by Infinity Value Capital Group to scale its AI driven SME finance platform, expand embedded lending, and accelerate GCC expansion.

item.title: Saudi proptech startup Safqah Capital secures $15.2 million to support SME developers
item.description: Saudi fintech proptech Safqah Capital secures $15.2 million in a seed funding round led by Shorooq, aiming to expand Shariah compliant real estate financing solutions and scale its AI underwriting capabilities.

item.title: InvestSky raises $4M seed round and expands Into Saudi Arabia
item.description: UAE based fintech InvestSky enters Saudi Arabia after a $4 million seed round and CMA approval, partnering with anb Capital to expand social first retail investing across the Kingdom and the wider MENA region.

item.title: Egypt’s Tactful AI lands $1M as it prepares for series A push
item.description: Egyptian CX startup Tactful AI secures $1 million in Pre-Series A funding to scale its agentic AI platform across Egypt and EMEA, with plans to accelerate R&D and target a Series A within 12 months.

item.title: Germany and Qatar Launch Deep Tech Innovation Hub in Doha
item.description: ESMT Berlin partners with Qatar Investment Authority and QRDI Council to launch DEEP Qatar innovation hub supporting 150+ deep tech projects over three years.

item.title: Saudi Trade Platform MUHIDE Closes Series A Backed by Asyad Group
item.description: Saudi Arabia's B2B trade platform MUHIDE has closed its Series A funding round with backing from Oman's Asyad Group to scale its digital commerce infrastructure.
